name: get_entity
description: Return one ontology entity by id (e.g. skill:agent-tdd, subagent:agent-tdd, sop:conventional-commits, philosophy:8, doc:edd). Ontology metadata only, not SOP bodies (use get_sop). Do not use this to open SOP file bodies or a host subagent launch SOP; never open a kit SOP with this tool.
